Mentioned in our stories

  • British Alternative Comedy Started in a Strip Club, Sixteen Days After ThatcherAn insurance salesman came back from a Los Angeles holiday, rented Saturday nights above a Soho topless bar, and ran a gong show. Within a year it had produced the cast of British television comedy for the next decade.
  • The Show That Won by Refusing to Finish a JokeMonty Python's Flying Circus recorded its first episode in September 1969 and made forty-five in four years. Its real innovation was structural: it abandoned the punchline, and therefore the whole architecture of the sketch show.
